tools.name: intel_availability
tools.description: [v1.3.0] 先查：available_now、coverage、requires_trigger。建议再调 chain/signal/brief。Check coverage status first: available_now, coverage, requires_trigger. Then chain/signal/brief.

tools.name: intel_signal
tools.description: [v1.3.0] 规则缺口（≈list_signals）：落地、商业化、技术，另有链主倒逼无点名承接、海外有卖国内供给空。Rule gaps: landing, commercialization, tech, plus chain-master with no named receiver, and overseas sales with empty China supply.

tools.name: intel_heal
tools.description: [v1.3.0] 和本站上次快照比，缺口类型这次没了、还在、或新出现（healed / persistent / new）。会写下这次快照。Compare gap types with this site's last snapshot: gone, still here, or new. Writes this snapshot.

tools.name: intel_brief
tools.description: [v1.3.0] 规则模板拼的缺口组合：落地、商业化、技术，以及链主、跨境，哪几条在。不是大模型。Template of which gap combination is present. Not an LLM.

tools.name: intel_tech_daily
tools.description: [v1.3.0] 技术日报词矩阵，与 /tech-daily 同一批行。无 Key 只给公开前 8 条。Tech-word heat matrix, same rows as /tech-daily. No key: public top 8 only.

tools.name: intel_category
tools.description: [v1.3.0] 单个品类的机会与供给。传 slug，与 /entity/{slug}.json 同一裁剪，不是实体列表。One category opportunity. Pass a slug. Same crop as /entity/{slug}.json. Not the entity index.

tools.name: intel_chain_master
tools.description: [v1.3.0] 已发布的链主倒逼。承接方不是定点供应商。公开档不给来源 URL。Published chain-master push. Receivers are not designated suppliers. Public tier hides source URLs.
